corrections.actual: C++ Image with position, dimensions and signed-char pixel mask; normalizeCols supplies reversible color normalization. Components and bounding boxes are DSL operations, not a mandatory Python graph conversion.
initFuncs3 registers scalar and vector image operations with costs; functions include color filters, rigid transforms, splits, joins, embedding and composition.

Cost-limited DAG state expansion followed by cross-example piece extraction, greedy composition and outer-product deduction. The active DAG::build loop iterates appended nodes; it is not the claimed A* search. Output-size deduction runs a separate piece search capped at cost 30.

evaluateCands accepts at least one exact training match, subject to output validity, and scores goods - .01*(max_depth + .001*cnt_pieces). It does not require every training example to match, and the runner exports predicted grids and scores rather than a saved executable program.

Test input participates in parallel DAG evaluation. Runner hash-deduplicates to at most three candidate grids, reverses color normalization, adjusts flip scores, and serializes answers. Python scheduler merges runs by descending (score, serialized image), exact string deduplication and top three.
